documentation_excerpts.text: Agent Retrieval Bench (ARB) evaluates the context-acquisition layer of coding agents: given a real workflow signal and a repository at a frozen base commit, can a retriever find the files an agent needs to read next, or correctly decide that the repository contains no useful local context?

ARB differs from generic semantic code search in its relevance definition. […] A failure trace may expose a test while the needed file is its root-cause implementation; a review comment may name one file while the missing constraint lives elsewhere.
